_comment: Written by the Security Review persona. The pre-tag CI job reads this to decide whether a release is covered by a current audit. Do not hand-edit.
open_findings: MEDIUM #96: durable audit trail — direction set (B+C), documentation deliverable deliberately sequenced after #101
LOW #98: note direction / echo-suppression relies on company-name matching
notes: Delta review covering #110 (docs: member package verification) and #111 (escape API-sourced values in the collaboration card). Reviewed for release v1.0.47.

SELF-REVIEWED: the same session authored and reviewed both changes. Evidence is reproducible rather than judgemental — esc() verified against a quote-breakout and tag-injection payload; notes render path re-checked and already fully escaped; sla.css confirmed locally generated, not API-sourced; node --check and package.sh both clean.

#111 note: the case token was removed from the DOM rather than escaped. It was interpolated into an id AND into querySelector('#actions-' + token) on the next line, so escaping at the write site would have desynced the read and still placed token text inside a CSS selector. The container is now found by class within its own card.
Category 7 (untrusted content rendering) applied for the first time as a checklist item rather than an ad-hoc lead; it is what #111 came from.
Remaining mechanical warning is the known v1-endpoint usage sunsetting 2027-01-01 (#101).

NOT re-probed this session: inbound webhook ingress authentication (still relying on the closed #90 disposition). SRI-vs-CDN and release-environment reviewer checks are point-in-time from the 96815ac review.
Connect_SDK deliberately out of scope: its active development is on an unmerged raw_impl branch, so main does not represent shippable code.
